Friend map and third-party map services

Friend map location display agreement (v2)

The map uses Baidu Maps and AMap SDKs to display the base map. Both providers process device and network information needed to provide maps. We initialize these SDKs only after you accept this agreement. We do not enable continuous vendor location tracking or background location. Before Baby Verification is complete, only a base map without any user locations may be displayed as the access-gate background. User locations are not queried, location permission is not requested, and your location is not reported.

By tapping I agree to the above agreement, you allow ABDL Space to display your location to other users at your chosen precision and visibility after you actively enable map appearance and report a location. Public means visible to logged-in users; mutual followers means visible only to people you follow who also follow you; hidden stops display. Appearance uses a software-fuzzed location, never the device's raw GPS coordinates. On first use, you must accept the agreement, complete Baby Verification, and explicitly choose who can see you. There is no default choice. Only after confirmation will location permission be requested and the map centered. When hidden, centering can remain local without reporting appearance coordinates. New selections of hidden or mutual-followers visibility are sponsor-only. Existing settings can be explicitly retained. Stopping display or withdrawing your location is always available, and visibility will never silently become public. You can adjust precision and visibility.

Reported locations remain stored and displayed at your selected precision and visibility. Going offline or logging out does not hide or delete them. They remain until you manually hide your location or delete your account. Hide it first if you do not want others to keep seeing it. Stop using this service removes the location and restores the first-use introduction. Reusing the service requires accepting the agreement and confirming visibility again. It does not delete your account, posts, or other user data, or reset system location permission. Visibility and confirmation requirements after sponsorship expires follow the latest server settings and will never automatically become public. Choosing a displayed location is a sponsor benefit, but everyone approved to use the map can browse all regions, regardless of city or sponsorship.

Read this agreement, the app privacy policy, and the Baidu and AMap SDK privacy policies in full. Scroll to the bottom before deciding whether to agree. If you decline, the map SDKs will not be initialized, and opening the map will not publish your location.

1. This certificate is generated by ABDL Space from Baby Verification review records to confirm that its holder completed the platform\'s verification process.

2. Verification photos are used only for identity review, integrity checks, and verification reassessment. They are not published publicly and are uploaded to private storage over a secure connection.
3. This certificate includes a unique number and an online validation credential. Scan the QR code or visit the official validation URL. Online status is authoritative.

4. This certificate only confirms that its holder passed ABDL Space Baby Verification. It is not an identity card, passport, or other legal identity document. It becomes invalid if replaced, revoked, or expired.
5. Do not forge, alter, copy, or transfer this certificate. Information changes, reissues, and revocations follow the records in the ABDL Space verification system.
